sprint_goal: Identify and fix the critical memory leak in Node.js user session service, validate stability under load, and enhance monitoring to prevent recurrence.

tasks.title: Set up controlled profiling environment using clinic.js
tasks.description: Prepare staging environment with identical configurations to production and integrate clinic.js for memory profiling under typical user load.

tasks.title: Perform memory profiling and heap analysis under simulated load
tasks.description: Execute memory profiling for 6-hour sessions simulating normal traffic, collect heap snapshots, and analyze persistent object references related to WebSocket and cache layers.

tasks.title: Identify specific leak source in session service
tasks.description: Correlate heap patterns with code modules, focusing on user cache and WebSocket notification handling to pinpoint exact root cause.

tasks.title: Implement fix for memory leak
tasks.description: Apply code-level fix for object retention or subscription mismanagement in WebSocket or cache layer, ensuring backward compatibility and unit test coverage.

tasks.title: Deploy fixed service to staging and execute 48-hour memory validation
tasks.description: Perform rolling restart in staging environment, monitor memory trends for 48 hours using Grafana dashboards to confirm leak resolution.

tasks.title: Execute 24-hour load test with 10,000 concurrent users
tasks.description: Run automated load testing scenarios replicating production traffic using k6 or similar, ensuring memory usage stability below 4GB per pod and normal CPU utilization.

tasks.title: Enhance monitoring and alerting mechanisms
tasks.description: Configure Grafana to trigger alerts if memory growth exceeds 500MB/day, add scheduled heap snapshot jobs, update dashboards for visibility.

tasks.title: Document root cause, fix steps, and monitoring configuration
tasks.description: Prepare detailed internal documentation outlining root cause, fix applied, validation steps, and monitoring strategy for future reference.

risks.description: Root cause may remain elusive after initial profiling sessions due to transient memory allocation patterns.
risks.mitigation: Conduct extended profiling with different traffic patterns and review code-level event listener cleanup.

risks.description: Fix could introduce unexpected behavior in real-time notifications and break backward compatibility.
risks.mitigation: Implement fix behind feature flag and run regression tests focused on WebSocket message handling.

risks.description: Monitoring alerts may generate excessive noise if thresholds are misconfigured.
risks.mitigation: Fine-tune alert thresholds after observing memory behaviors during staging tests.

definition_of_done: Root cause of memory leak clearly identified through profiling.
Code fix implemented, peer-reviewed, and unit tested.
Staging validation confirms stable memory behavior under load.
Monitoring alerts and heap snapshot automation successfully deployed.
Documentation published in team knowledge base.
Load test shows memory stabilization under 4GB per pod over 24 hours.
